import numpy as np
import datetime

def task_func(arr):
    arr = np.asarray(arr)

    def reverse_by_dot(value):
        text = str(value)
        parts = [part.strip() for part in text.split(".") if part.strip()]
        return ".".join(parts[::-1]) if parts else ""

    result = np.empty(arr.shape, dtype=object)
    for idx in np.ndindex(arr.shape):
        result[idx] = reverse_by_dot(arr[idx])

    return result
